subject.title: Mobile apps: offline session cache with instant cold open (iOS + Android)

question: Should OpenClaw mobile apps persist recent chat transcripts locally as a disposable read-only cache, and what security contract must the iOS and Android PRs satisfy before merge?
rationale: This is not a narrow bug fix: it adds local storage for sensitive transcript data across two mobile apps and needs maintainer intent on protection, retention, cache clearing, and platform parity.

options.title: Sponsor shared cache contract
options.body: Define the security and reconciliation contract, then use the open iOS and Android PRs as the implementation path once proof and merge risks are cleared.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask contributors to first land a shared design or one platform behind the agreed contract before accepting both app implementations.

options.title: Defer local transcript persistence
options.body: Keep mobile chat gateway-first until maintainers are ready to own local transcript storage and its security review burden.

recommendation.title: Sponsor shared cache contract
recommendation.body: Define the security and reconciliation contract, then use the open iOS and Android PRs as the implementation path once proof and merge risks are cleared.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the assignee and authored the currently linked candidate implementations for this exact cache direction.
